title: Senior Data Analyst -  Windsor CT-(5 Days office Onsite)
description:
Position: Senior Data Analyst
Location: Windsor CT-(5 Days office Onsite)
Rate: DOE

Role Overview
We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead analytical initiatives, design advanced reporting solutions, and deliver actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate will work closely with business leaders, data engineers, and BI teams to ensure high-quality, accurate, and timely data analysis.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the design and development of reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

  • Conduct advanced SQL-based queries and optimize performance for large datasets.
  • Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership in a clear, concise manner.
  • Contribute to the design of self-service reporting frameworks for business users.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and privacy policies.
  • Stay current with emerging tools and techniques to improve analytics capabilities.
Required Skills & Qualifications
  • 7–10 years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL and working with relational and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred).
  • Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik) with proven dashboard development experience.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing concepts.
  • Proficiency in Excel (advanced formulas, macros, pivot tables).

title: Business Analyst – Hardware Asset Management (HAM) (Remote)
description:
Job Title: Business Analyst – Hardware Asset Management (HAM) (Remote)
Location: Mexico or Costa Rica (Must be available to work Pacific Standard Time hours)
Job Summary
We are seeking a detail-oriented Business Analyst – Hardware Asset Management (HAM) to support hardware asset management operations by maintaining accurate asset records, analyzing data, and delivering actionable reports. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, excels in spreadsheet management, and is experienced with ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure asset data integrity throughout the hardware lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain and manage hardware asset data across all lifecycle stages, including procurement, deployment, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Track and reconcile hardware inventory to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets using Microsoft Excel to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Create and maintain reports on asset inventory, utilization, lifecycle status, and service requests.
  • Update and manage asset records, requests, and workflows within ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform.
  • Monitor asset requests and provide timely status updates to stakeholders.
  • Ensure the completeness and accuracy of asset information across multiple systems.
  • Collaborate with IT, procurement, and operations teams to validate hardware asset records.
  • Support the creation of dashboards, reports, and performance metrics for management and stakeholders.
  • Assist in improving asset management processes and maintaining compliance with organizational standards.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data cleanup, filtering, and reporting.
  • Basic understanding of Hardware Asset Management (HAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM) principles.
  • Experience working with ServiceNow or similar ticketing/IT service management platforms.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage, organize, and interpret large datasets.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting Hardware Asset Management or IT Asset Management operations.
  • Familiarity with asset lifecycle management and inventory tracking systems.
  • Experience with reporting tools and dashboard creation (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices is an advantage.
Key Competencies
  • Exceptional attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends and recommend improvements.
  • Ability to manage repetitive, data-intensive tasks efficiently.
  • Collaborative approach with excellent stakeholder communication skills.
  • Adaptability in a fast-paced, process-driven environment.

title: Payroll Specialist -Workday
description:
Position: Payroll Specialist - Workday.
Location: Guatemala
Duration: 6 Months

The Payroll Specialist will process biweekly payroll, perform payroll audits, process garnishments, and other payroll t
associated duties as assigned.

Duties/Responsibilities:
  • Enters, maintains, and/or processes information in the payroll system; information may include employees'
hourly rates, salaries, commissions, bonuses or other compensation, time worked, paid leave and holidays,
deductions and withholding, and other information.
  • End to end payroll processing using Workday and ADP
  • Ensures proper processing of payroll deductions for taxes, benefits, and other deductions.
  • Audits payroll using reporting from Workday.
  • Issues, or reissues, physical or replacement checks or direct deposits due to payroll errors or final discharge.
  • Enter and maintain wage garnishments using ADP.
  • Assists with new-hire orientations to discuss payroll topics.
  • Assists with distribution of materials related to payroll changes.
  • Provides necessary reports for allocation/billing charges.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Excellent organizational skills, time management skills, and attention to detail.
  • Extensive knowledge of payroll and applicable laws.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Proficient with or the ability to quickly learn payroll software.
  • Experience processing payroll using Workday and ADP.
  • Knowledge of US federal and state tax laws

Education and Experience:
  • Associate's degree in accounting/human resources or related field, but experience and/or other training/certification may be substituted for the education.
  • A minimum of three years of experience in payroll preferred.
  • Physical Requirements:
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
